items.title: Suno launches MCP server to 'create music right from the chat'
items.excerpt: Suno opened an early-access MCP server so users can generate songs from inside Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude Code and Cursor; tracks use normal Suno credits and land in the user's Suno library, for free and paid tiers.
items.rationale: New product release: you can now run Suno from inside the AI assistants people already work in, on both free and paid tiers.

items.title: Avenged Sevenfold's Zacky Vengeance Defends AI Art, Calls Majority of Designers He's Worked With 'Lazy'
items.excerpt: After fans flagged the artwork for A7X's Misfits 'Horror Business' cover as AI-generated, Zacky Vengeance said he 'fully embraces AI', prefers 'my prompts', and called most designers he has worked with lazy — reigniting the album-art vs. AI debate.
items.rationale: A fresh flashpoint over AI-made album art, and the cover designers who are losing that work, from a major band.

items.title: A$AP Rocky Accused Of Plagiarizing Part Of AI-Assisted 'Shroom Clouds' Video
items.excerpt: VFX artist Cache Bunny says a psychedelic tunnel shot in A$AP Rocky's 'Shroom Clouds' video lifts a 2019 GoPro Fusion piece and was altered with AI; the video credits list two 'AI Artist' roles.
items.rationale: A new case of AI being used to rework an artist's footage without credit in a big music video, which raises the question of who gets credited.

items.title: Pozalabs reveals AI producer Steal Saturday as its own act
items.excerpt: Seoul AI-music company Pozalabs released a five-song ballad album by AI producer Steal Saturday on Oct. 26 and, for the first time, publicly identified the act as one it created.
items.rationale: New album release plus a first public disclosure that a Korean AI-music company is behind an AI act, at a time when AI labels are under scrutiny.

items.title: "AI 썼다고 밝히면 저작권료 못 받는 현실"…국회서 분배 기준 논의
items.excerpt: 김재원·배현진 의원이 국회에서 'AI 활용 음악' 저작권료 분배 기준 토론회를 열고, AI 사용을 정직하게 신고한 창작자만 저작권료를 못 받는 구조를 바로잡을 기준을 논의했다.
items.rationale: A National Assembly forum on royalty-split rules for AI-assisted music, which bears directly on how Korean creators get paid.
